description: Builds and saves a full workout from ordered exercise and rest steps in one call. Use when the user lists the exercises, reps or times they want, or wants to save a draft from create_similar_workout. Not for AI-generated workouts (use generate_workout) or editing an existing one (use update_workout). Returns the new workout's ID, name and length.

category_ids.description: Workout category IDs from list_workout_categories, e.g. for HIIT or Yoga. Omit for none.

description.description: Short description members see on the workout. Omit for none.

difficulty.description: Level: beginner, intermediate or advanced. Omit to leave unset.

name.description: Workout name, 3 characters or more, e.g. "Core Blast 20".

steps.description: Ordered steps, 1 to 100. Each is an exercise {exercise_id, reps or duration_seconds, pace?, weight_level?, rpe?} or a rest {rest_seconds}. Needs at least one exercise; the first and last steps can't be rest.

items.description: One step: an exercise (exercise_id plus reps or duration_seconds) or a rest (rest_seconds only).

duration_seconds.description: Seconds for a timed exercise step, e.g. 40. Set reps or duration_seconds, not both.

exercise_id.description: Exercise for this step, from list_team_exercises. Leave out on a rest step.

pace.description: Tempo cue for an exercise step: slow, medium or fast. Omit for none.

reps.description: Reps for a reps-based exercise step, e.g. 12. Set reps or duration_seconds, not both.

rest_seconds.description: Makes this a rest step of this many seconds, e.g. 20. Leave out every exercise field.

rpe.description: Target effort for an exercise step, 0 to 10 (rate of perceived exertion). Omit or 0 for none.

weight_level.description: Load cue for an exercise step: light, medium or heavy. Omit for none.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

visibility.description: public = members can see it in the app; private = team only (private needs a plan that includes it).

name: build_workout
title: Build a workout
